result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with marked high-visibility crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or medians increase exposure for people crossing.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Wide corner radii
hazards.description: The geometry of the corners may allow for higher vehicle turning speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane urban arterial with high-visibility crosswalks but no pedestrian refuge. The environment is dominated by vehicle traffic, with long crossing distances that increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: There is no median or island for pedestrians to wait safely if they cannot complete the crossing in one signal cycle.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area and reduce effective crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features wide roadways with faded crosswalk markings and a lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the large crossing distance and car-oriented design create significant exposure for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The markings across the main thoroughfare are significantly worn, reducing visibility of the crossing zone to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crossing area across the main road

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge island.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility for approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on safe crossing intervals.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane arterial road with a marked zebra crosswalk and signalized control. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the long crossing distance and lack of physical pedestrian refuge increase exposure risk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least five lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A white van parked near the crosswalk may block sightlines between approaching drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Physical Refuge
hazards.description: The center median is painted rather than raised, providing no physical protection for pedestrians caught mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised concrete island in the center median to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.
